policy: Observed Korean composer worklists and bilingual public orchestra programmes, with per-row source review and identity guards. Existing Korean titles are never overwritten. Primary programme usage is preferred for new display titles where available. Names observed in one source do not establish popularity. Unresolved names remain missing; no guessed translations or shorthand. Imported works remain review-only.
